messages:
alex: Quick check — Kestrel POC timeline. Can we lock integration windows and owners? SE needs a go/no-go by next week.

maria: Owners I have: Maria (SE), Jordan (Platform Eng), Devon (Infra). Alex — do we also need a PM?

jordan: Staging cluster looks free week of Apr 7. I can carve out Apr 8 08:00-12:00 UTC for deploy + smoke tests. Need firewall rules and a service account from the customer.

devon: Created infra ticket INF-4123. What customer IP ranges and ports do we need opened? Also request SSH bastion access window for initial setup.

alex: @katie-se please confirm SE success criteria so we can prioritize tests. Also we should pin SDK versions in the runbook.

katie-se: SE success criteria: 1) >=95% intent accuracy on our eval set, 2) p90 latency <150ms for short prompts, 3) zero auth errors during a 24h soak. We'll deliver eval set + expected labels by EOD today.

maria: Noted. We'll also ask customer for sample payloads to validate schema mapping. Recommend using python-sdk v1.3.2 (avoid v1.4 due to API changes).

jordan: We'll pin runtime and client to v1.3.2 for the trial. Devon — can you list exact outbound endpoints/ports to request?

devon: Open outbound 443 to api.redwood.ai and metrics.redwood.ai. Internal kube probes need 10250. SSH bastion on 22 during setup window only. Also we need customer to allow inbound to the bastion IP.

maria: SE will provide a quick smoke curl test for staging:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://staging.kestrel.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```

alex: @deploy-bot can you reserve the staging slot and CI window for Apr 8? Also tag owners on the deploy runbook.

deploy-bot: Staging slot confirmed: Apr 8 09:00-12:00 UTC. CI window: Apr 8 08:00-10:00 UTC. Assigned on-call: @jordan, @devon. (scheduled by deploy-bot)

jordan: I'll run the deploy and smoke tests during CI window. @maria please send customer staging creds via secure channel (do not post here).

maria: Will share creds and eval set in the secure workspace by EOD. Quick question — do we start with the quantized model for perf or full fp16?

katie-se: Start with quantized variant to validate perf. Then run fp16 for quality comparison on the eval set, log diffs, and decide final variant.

alex: Action recap: 1) Maria send creds + eval set (EOD). 2) Devon confirm firewall rules + SSH bastion details in INF-4123. 3) Jordan runs deploy Apr 8 08:00-10:00 (CI) / 09:00-12:00 (smoke). 4) Alex will create POC checklist GH PR and link INF-4123 and POC ticket. Any blockers?

devon: One dependency: customer must allow outbound to metrics.redwood.ai:443 for observability. Maria please confirm with them.

maria: I'll check and update INF-4123.

alex: I'll open JIRA POC-998 and add owners + checklist. Thanks all :thumbsup:
